summary: Iteration 81: Warehouse Release (outbound hand-over) flow end-to-end test. Wrote pytest suite covering redemption -> pending -> release -> history -> PDF -> re-pawn -> payment-delete revert (16 tests, all passing). UI E2E validated: 4 tabs on /warehouse-receipts (wh-tab-pending/history/release/released), Ready-for-release queue with card + Release dialog (prefills client name), save flow shows 'Item released' toast, Released tab count increments, gate-pass PDF button appears in history table. /items page shows 'Awaiting pickup' and 'Released' filter chips with counts. Business dashboard loads without crashing.

issues: Recharts container reports width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount (visual charts still render). Consider providing an explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer wrappers.

critical_code_review_comments: warehouse.py release_item correctly $unset active_contract_id and sets status 'released'.
releases_pending correctly filters orphan contracts (no item doc) - good.
Release dialog uses Radix Select for condition; default value 'good' works even when option click intercepted (fine).
PDF endpoint uses get_current_user (any auth user) rather than require_module('warehouse'); acceptable but consider tightening if audit desired.
seed_data_creation: Test contracts + payments are created and cleaned up within the pytest module and UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter81_warehouse_release.py. If DB in_stock car count runs low, tests skip gracefully.
